## Personality

Dorothy Gardner is a slim individual with a tomboyish demeanor. Known for her jolly personality, she also demonstrates an ardent and impulsive nature when offering good wishes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P32](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0032)_

## History

Dorothy, along with her mother and sister, visited [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) a day earlier than expected, resulting in an awkward yet ultimately successful first meeting despite a ruined chocolate cake and cat chaos. Later, rumor spread among the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) graduates that Dorothy's brother, [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), was engaged to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P0](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0000), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P2](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0002), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P4](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0004), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P6](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0006), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), +81 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--dorothy.md)

Dorothy is close friends with [Anne](../character/anne.md) during their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Their friendship involves sharing social gatherings, including a walking party and conversations with their circle of friends as they finish examinations and prepare for graduation. Dorothy remains a constant companion to [Anne](../character/anne.md) throughout major life events, including the period around Phil's wedding.

- Friend of — close friends  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

Dorothy is the sister of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She, alongside her mother and other sister, made a visit to call on [Anne](../character/anne.md) at Patty's Place, an interaction that turned out successfully despite an unexpected early arrival and minor domestic chaos. She also maintains connections within the shared social circle that includes her brother and [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>
